_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'.
name: autocode
description: Run a project's primary session as an autocode agent under OpenCode 2: autocode.rule.md (always-on, dormant outside a session whose shells carry AUTOCODE_SESSION) replaces what the persona ties to harness hooks and the session clock - start (register the agent ID; Solaris self-compaction is off for a project with this plugin attached, copied or linked, and a session outside a project turns it off with session_compact set-limit off, so autocode's compaction is the only one; the read-first set read by hand), wakes as the clock (recurring events as cron wakes, one-shots as at wakes, a fire-only wake for background jobs, an idle guard wake in place of the Stop hook), the compaction-next turn as the context.md save point and compaction done as the cue to go on with what is left, workers as OpenCode subagents or autocode jobs, peers and the owner through autocode messages, questions and approvals, GPU hosts from the fleet agent the project names through the per-GPU locks it hands out, hand logging and autocode spend; tools/wakes.py prints wake specs from <pack>/.memory/schedule.json (recurring events as UTC cron triggers that keep today's instants, one-shots ahead as at triggers, --skip-prefix for events another agent owns, --show for one event's whole note).

notes: Needs OpenCode 2 with the autocode plugin connected to an autocode server on the machine that runs the session (autocode_me action=status answers).

The owner sets the compaction threshold per ID pattern on the server (autocode settings set compact_at <tokens> --match '<pattern>'); attaching this plugin turns Solaris self-compaction off for the project (only the project's own selfcompact.enabled turns it back on).
Record the session's agent ID and start prompt under an 'Autocode' heading in <pack>/instructions.md at the first start.
